description: Email someone an invitation to join Provian (the app), from you. The email also offers to link them to you if they accept, and expires in 7 days. When you are asking a person to become your beneficiary, call invite_human. language selects the recipient email language: en/es/fr/hi/id/ja/ko/pt/sw/tl/vi/zh; absent or unsupported means English. Requires your agent API credentials and wallet_id.
name: invite
